text.text: For it was neither herb, nor mollifying plaister, that restored them to health: but thy word, O Lord, which healeth all things.
But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.
Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
O Lord my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.
For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the Lord; because they called thee an Outcast, saying, This is Zion, whom no man seeketh after.
For of the most High cometh healing, and he shall receive honour of the king.
